releaseChecklist.required: npm ci, npm run check, npm test, npm audit --omit=dev, npm pack, clean consumer archive install, CLI help/doctor, local-only smoke; record artifact hash and exact environment.
Upgrade previous package/artifact, inspect existing CPB_HOME, restore previous version, and verify records remain intact; record commands and outcome.
releaseChecklist.note: No in-product updater or upgrade/rollback drill is recorded.

releaseChecklist.required: Stop all bridge/provider processes, back up complete private CPB_HOME including scheduler.sqlite, run records/events and retained recovery workspaces, restore into isolated directory, run list/inspect, and verify integrity.
releaseChecklist.note: Existing persistence/restart tests do not constitute an offline backup/restore drill.

releaseChecklist.required: Check absent CLI/key, invalid credentials, provider error, malformed state, and cancellation. Verify explicit unknown/unavailable/logged-out states and that JSON/events do not disclose credentials, prompt, source content, or raw provider stderr.
Review exact production dependency tree and lifecycle scripts, verify lockfile, run supported dependency advisory audit, and record third-party license/SBOM review and dispositions.
releaseChecklist.note: npm audit evidence does not establish license compatibility or complete inventory.

releaseChecklist.required: State minimum versus tested versions separately; run clean install/build/test/smoke for each claimed OS and Node combination, including process cancellation and storage checks.
releaseChecklist.note: Linux and additional Node versions are not established by the recorded run.
